scripts.build:host: bun build host/src/main.ts --outfile ui/host.js --format esm --target browser
scripts.build:ui: bun run build:host && NSH="${NSH:-nsh}" && { command -v "$NSH" >/dev/null || { echo "build:ui 需要 nsh：把 NSH 设成 nsh 可执行文件的路径，或把 nsh 放进 PATH" >&2; exit 1; }; } && LLVM="${LLVM_BIN:-/opt/homebrew/opt/llvm/bin}" && CC_wasm32_unknown_unknown="${CC_wasm32_unknown_unknown:-$LLVM/clang}" AR_wasm32_unknown_unknown="${AR_wasm32_unknown_unknown:-$LLVM/llvm-ar}" "$NSH" package ui --target web
